faq.q1: How long does it take to build a pool?
faq.a1: It depends on the size and features, but it typically takes between 2 and 4 weeks.
faq.q2: What does the patio construction service include?
faq.a2: It includes custom design, land leveling, flooring installation, landscaping, and finishes.
faq.a3: Yes, we offer both preventive and corrective maintenance for residential and commercial pools.
faq.q4: Can I automate the filtration system?
faq.a4: Yes, we offer automation systems that increase maintenance efficiency.
faq.q5: Do you work with custom designs?
faq.a5: Yes, every project is custom-designed based on the client's needs and preferences.
faq.a6: We offer warranties of up to 10 years depending on the type of work and materials used.
faq.q7: Can you install wet areas like jacuzzis or steam rooms?
faq.a7: Yes, we specialize in building wet areas including jacuzzis, steam rooms, and saunas.
faq.q8: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a8: We accept bank transfers, deposits, and customized agreements depending on the project.
faq.q9: What steps should I follow to start a project?
faq.a9: First, contact us. Then we schedule a site visit, design your project, and provide a detailed proposal.
faq.q10: What kind of materials do you use?
faq.a10: We use high-quality, durable materials suitable for outdoor and wet environments.
faq.q11: How much does a basic pool cost?
faq.a11: The price depends on size, depth, and finishes, but we offer free personalized quotes.
faq.q12: Do you have eco-friendly or sustainable options?
faq.a12: Yes, we offer low-energy consumption systems and efficient water recirculation setups.
faq.q13: Do you also renovate existing pools or patios?
faq.a13: Yes, we provide renovation, modernization, and aesthetic improvement services for existing spaces.
faq.q14: What does a technical visit or quote include?
faq.a14: It includes site inspection, measurements, design proposal, and a detailed budget.
faq.q15: How can I schedule a visit or consultation?
faq.a15: You can contact us via WhatsApp, email, or the contact form on our website.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This page explains what information we receive when you contact us through the form and how we use it.
privacy.contact_text: Integral Pool operates this website's contact form. Email info@integralpool.com or call +1 786 770 1666 with questions about your information.
privacy.data_text: We receive your name and email address and, if you choose to provide them, your phone number, company, and project details. The server temporarily uses your IP address to limit repeated submissions.
privacy.purpose_text: We use this information to answer your message, discuss your project, prepare a proposal, and arrange a visit if requested.
privacy.access_text: Your message is emailed to the Integral Pool team responsible for inquiries. The website uses the hosting and email services needed to receive it.
privacy.rights_text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of the information you sent by emailing info@integralpool.com. Include the email address used in your request so we can identify it.
